changes_made: VULN-008 is a compensating-control fix. The full remediation (httpOnly cookie) requires ApplinX REST API backend changes. Client-side mitigations applied: (1) VULN-001 CSS injection fixed — primary attack chain entry point eliminated; (2) VULN-002 keyboard mapping eval fixed — secondary attack chain entry point eliminated; (3) VULN-012 logger.service.ts: Bearer token no longer sent to remote log endpoint. The token remains in sessionStorage as the ApplinX REST API client-side SDK requires it. Migrating to httpOnly cookie is tracked as a follow-up requiring ApplinX REST API changes.

files_modified.file: StorageService (no change to token storage itself); logger.service.ts (token no longer leaked to log endpoint — VULN-012 fix); VULN-001 and VULN-002 fixes eliminate the main XSS vectors that would enable token theft.
